text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify plate state before campaign"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate, routine init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline film, 200 nm nominal"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"label":"standard crystallization step (nominal recipe)","comment":"per lab SOP recipe A; temperature field copied from recipe sheet"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"select spot on annealed film"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm2, standard OER benchmark"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"NiFeCo_v3","objective":"overpotential_min"},"comment":"log results to active-learning model"}]}
